experimental_unit_and_target.fail_closed_rule: Any alternative target name, construction, polarity, issue/fix mapping, or upstream label revision requires a versioned methodological amendment before use.
experimental_unit_and_target.negative_semantics: 0 = closed-world nominal negative; not proof that the commit is exhaustively defect-free
experimental_unit_and_target.positive_semantics: 1 = source benchmark identifies this observation commit as bug-inducing/defect-prone

semantic_separation: issue evidence can identify a reported bug but is not itself a predictor label
a fixing commit implements a repair and is not the defect-prone observation by that fact

the attributed bug-inducing commit is the positive prediction unit
fixing commits, issue links, SZZ outputs and attribution evidence are target provenance only and are forbidden predictors

external_validation_eligibility.partial_compatibility: report the exact modalities/claims tested and explicitly state every claim that cannot be externally validated
external_validation_eligibility.selection: construct compatibility must be assessed before performance access; favorable results cannot determine dataset choice

factorial_governance: All seven are evaluated under identical temporal origins; sign-neutral reporting is mandatory and C+P+T has no preferred status.

fitted_state_persistence.authorization_rule: final evaluation is forbidden until every applicable fitted component is persisted, reload-tested, schema-identified and SHA-256 identified
fitted_state_persistence.configuration_reproducibility: identifies code, schemas, hyperparameters, seeds and deterministic procedures but does not prove identity of fitted parameters
fitted_state_persistence.fitted_object_reproducibility: requires serialized fitted parameters/objects plus canonical state digest for the exact predictor that generated evaluation outputs
required_checks: prediction-equivalence check on a non-final deterministic fixture

fusion_governance.final_outcome_use: prohibited for weights, architecture or selection
fusion_governance.fixed: weights/rule must be declared before evaluation
fusion_governance.learned: fit only from nested out-of-time development predictions; base learners cannot predict their own fit rows

inherited_sprint_31_31a_restrictions.sprint_31_test: immutable historical evidence only; never rerun, rescore, refit, reconstruct as original, tune against, or use for feature/model/fusion/calibration/threshold/XAI choice
inherited_sprint_31_31a_restrictions.sprint_31a_limit: original fitted RF/LR objects were not persisted; reconstructed objects are audit reconstructions and cannot be presented as the originals

new_campaign_test_governance.final_evaluation: untouched later-period or eligible external holdout, opened once after complete freeze
new_campaign_test_governance.post_final_adaptation: prohibited; any later model is a new version and needs a new untouched boundary
new_campaign_test_governance.repeated_temporal_evaluation: must precede any final holdout opening
new_campaign_test_governance.separation_from_sprint_31: the new final boundary is not the sealed historical Sprint 31 TEST

new_campaign_test_governance.training: only the chronological training prefix at an authorized origin
new_campaign_test_governance.validation_and_selection: only later development blocks nested within the development pool

chronology_constraints: every fit timestamp precedes or is deterministically ordered before every row it predicts
a row is never predicted by a model fitted on that row
all fitted transformations use the same training membership as their estimator
temporal_protocol.eligible_development_pool: canonical historical TRAIN plus VALIDATION only; sealed Sprint 31 TEST is excluded from every new-campaign decision

final_boundary.if_unavailable: do not substitute Sprint 31 TEST; remain development-only or use an independently eligible external dataset
final_boundary.rule: a separately materialized, provenance-compatible later period whose commits are strictly later per project than all campaign-development observations; freeze membership, dataset digest, predictor configuration and all fitted-state digests before one opening

minimum_support.action_if_infeasible: record the project-window as infeasible and do not move boundaries, pool future outcomes backward, or choose a replacement after inspecting results
minimum_support.training: at least 2 positives and 2 nominal negatives
minimum_support.validation_or_evaluation: at least 1 positive and 1 nominal negative

temporal_protocol.model_selection: only aggregate development-origin evidence under predeclared metrics may select configurations; Sprint 31 TEST and new final outcomes are forbidden selection inputs

origin_generation.rounding: floor for boundaries; identical timestamps remain atomic by deterministic commit_hash tie-break
origin_generation.rule: within each project, sort the eligible development pool and assign each observation an integer rank; use five expanding origins at rank fractions 1/2, 3/5, 7/10, 4/5 and 9/10; training is the strict prefix and evaluation is the contiguous block to the next origin (the fifth ends at 1); omit no row because of its label
origin_generation.window: expanding train, non-overlapping next blocked evaluation

temporal_protocol.project_handling: form deterministic within-project chronological sequences, then aggregate aligned out-of-time predictions; project is metadata and never a predictor
temporal_protocol.validation_rule: inside each origin's training prefix, any tuning/fusion/calibration split must be an earlier expanding prefix followed by a later contiguous validation block using the same ordering; nested temporal predictions only

unresolved_limitations: The repository preserves the pinned upstream is_buggy_commit label and its identity chain, but does not independently reconstruct the benchmark creator's issue/fixing/SZZ attribution for every positive.
The later new-campaign final-period membership cannot exist until a provenance-compatible later snapshot is materialized; its deterministic eligibility rule is frozen here.
Natural commit text may contain defect/fix language; the canonical design permits raw text but forbids explicit keyword proxy features and label-informed processing.

xai_governance.readiness: only after empirical comparison selects and freezes a scientifically accepted fitted predictor
rules: use only data permitted for the explanation purpose
do not modify an already evaluated predictor from post-hoc explanations
